blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Lawmakers are considering an inquiry into possible links between pro-China propaganda networks and online supporters of Vice President Sara Duterte, Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon said Monday. Ridon said members of the House of Representatives had noticed an “intersectionality” between online “propagandists” promoting Chinese talking points and networks “defending” the Duterte political family.
